summary: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a save-the-date announcement that it will release third quarter 2026 financial results on Friday, November 6, 2026, before market open, followed by an earnings conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET hosted by CEO Rod West and CFO Rob Stefani. The filing provides dial-in details, webcast and presentation access, and a standard forward-looking information caution. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine earnings-scheduling notice with no special-situation implications, and no deal terms apply.
